CVE-2018-7738 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in bash-completion/umount that allows local users to gain privileges by embedding shell commands in a mountpoint name, which is mishandled during a umount command. This vulnerability requires both bash and access to the mount/umount commands. While bash is present in the container, the mount and umount commands are not available in this hardened Docker container, making this vulnerability not exploitable.
